title: GraniteFlowExtractionRiskFeatureSchema
description: Pre-review feature schema for predicting row extraction risk without ground truth leakage.

raw_text_length.description: Character length of the predicted row OCR text snippet.

token_count.description: Number of whitespace-separated tokens in the raw row.

parsed_dimensions_count.description: Number of dimension axes successfully extracted (0 to 3).

has_block_number_pattern.description: 1 if block number follows alphanumeric quarry pattern, 0 otherwise.

is_cbm_formula_consistent.description: 1 if reported CBM equals calculated volume within 0.005 tolerance.

cbm_reported_vs_calc_diff.description: Absolute difference between extracted CBM and calculated CBM.

has_excessive_allowance.description: 1 if allowance is >= any gross dimension.

target.name: needs_review
target.description: 1: NEEDS_REVIEW (requires human correction), 0: LOW_OBSERVED_RISK (clean approved match)
